subject: Next-round proposal: prepare AI Studio, Flow and Gemini before any Go; Comfy excluded
body:
Ziggy's final ordering supersedes the earlier broad-tab suggestion. NEXT ROUND only, while leaving the current Comfy executor/browser work undisturbed: fully populate ALL THREE distinct Google surfaces—AI Studio, Flow, and Google Gemini—before pressing Go in ANY of them. Then one operator performs a short sequential submission pass and confirms accepted/queued/running status and the actual job/task identifier or equivalent provider receipt after each before moving to the next. A click is not acceptance. This proposal applies only to existing approved independent tasks; it authorizes no extra paid job, new task, purchase, quota increase or automatic retry.

Before any Go: each task has exact correct source hashes/reference roles, intended model/mode and output count, valid settings/timing, all uploads complete, prompt readback, actual cost/allowance check and its independent dependencies satisfied. Verify persistence and session/login context on EACH surface; Google Gemini and AI Studio are distinct, and shared limits/persistence cannot be assumed. Fully preparing a form is not evidence that the provider accepted a job. If any of the three is ineligible, upload-incomplete, dependent on a missing accepted frame/official timing/reference, or lacking an allowed cost/run boundary, the requested all-three-ready phase is not established: report the precise blocker and keep the prepared records rather than inventing a new task/job.

Cloud compute might overlap after separate jobs have demonstrably been accepted, but this has not been measured for the current three sessions. Quotas, rates, session persistence, local browser resources and overlap availability are unknown. Do not deliberately crash, treat disconnect survival as guaranteed, or duplicate a job after an uncertain submit. Inspect the provider and previous job state before retrying, within existing authorization. This is a manual operating proposal, not a scheduler installation or an active dispatch instruction.

Current file/tool evidence: CFA's existing Cantina Comfy proof remains in source/workflow preflight; saved manifest generationSubmitted=false with jobID/output/cost null; latest owner report says credits restored. Supported task reads still show active/waitingOnApproval, with pending action/reason unexposed. No new Comfy accepted/queued/rendering job is established by those records. Comfy stays excluded from this Google three-surface plan. Flow A/B already returned but both current reviews are Scene/Preliminary/Needs fixes; a further diagnostic C is proposed/unrun. AI Studio's prior bounded second pass is historical completed analysis with listening provenance unverified; no new Google submission is authorized merely by this process proposal.

Please retain as a NEXT-ROUND proposal in the existing coordination record and review eligible existing Google tasks later, without interrupting or changing current Comfy work. No new owner prompt/browser control is sent by this file-only relay.

Correlation: GOOGLE-THREE-SURFACE-PRESTAGE-20261012
